pin.scope: Shell keyboard bridge plus host pacing only after completed video frames; guest CPU/peripheral timing is unchanged.

peripherals.name: happy-none
peripherals.firmware: built-in high-level model; quiet command only

observer.mode: same binary, EXEC816_LATENCY_TRACE and EXEC816_MASK_TRACE environment gates; replay with both unset

keyboard_input.mode: POKEY matrix scan; PushRawKey/ReleaseRawKey immediate=false; modifier matrix transitions
keyboard_input.initialization: KEY ALL up enables scan mode before modifier changes

play_validation.scope: Disk command loading, physical BREAK during loading, recovery and heap/ownership restoration

diagnostic_image.scope: Retained optimized diagnostic build, with bounded loader/sector observers; passive CPU markers add no guest instructions.

stopped.interpretation: Wall-clock intervals include preemption and other system workers; consume is not exclusive copy CPU time. Call and Pump totals overlap phase totals; nested or suspended call durations are not additive. Read boundaries are observed DOS submissions, not inferred from sector count.

active.interpretation: Wall-clock intervals include preemption and other system workers; consume is not exclusive copy CPU time. Call and Pump totals overlap phase totals; nested or suspended call durations are not additive. Read boundaries are observed DOS submissions, not inferred from sector count.

limits: Consecutive phase intervals are elapsed times and include task suspension or interrupt work.
Call durations overlap phase intervals and may overlap one another; they are not additive CPU costs.
The profile uses the recorded diagnostic executable; the uninstrumented play image is separately rebuilt and smoke tested.
The emitted HELLO data layout is checked as sectors 70 through 88. This is a scoped 128-byte-sector diagnostic, not a general media profiler.
No full release or compiler qualification is claimed.
